##### Project general facts 

Chelsea Residences by DAMAC is an ultra-luxury waterfront development located in Dubai Maritime City. The project consists of six architecturally distinctive towers developed in two phases, offering a curated collection of 1- to 3-bedroom residences. Designed with a contemporary approach that blends elegant coastal aesthetics with urban sophistication, the development provides residents with panoramic sea views and excellent connectivity to key districts such as Port Rashid, DIFC, and Downtown Dubai, making it a strategically positioned branded residential destination.
 
The project offers an extensive range of lifestyle, wellness, and sports-inspired amenities designed to create a resort-like living experience. These include infinity pools, aerial yoga spaces, jogging tracks, outdoor gyms, and dedicated wellness zones such as cryotherapy, water treatment tunnels, rain therapy areas, and forest relaxation pods. Additional lifestyle features include a Chelsea Football simulation room, kids’ underwater-themed play areas, and the exclusive Chelsea Blue Beach Club, creating a diverse environment that blends recreation, fitness, and relaxation.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials including porcelain tiled flooring, painted plastered walls, and gypsum ceilings, complemented by double-glazed windows and balconies as per layout. Kitchens are fully fitted with refrigerator, cooker, hood, washing machine, and RO system. The residences are semi-furnished with built-in wardrobes where applicable, while overall finishing reflects a modern, durable, and refined residential standard focused on comfort and functionality.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a dynamic and specialized community at the core of Dubai, dedicated to serving the maritime industry. As a comprehensive maritime hub, it offers a full spectrum of infrastructure, services, and facilities that support shipbuilding, maintenance, and a wide range of marine-related activities.

The area is purposefully designed to accommodate maritime businesses and professionals, featuring advanced shipyards, dry docks, and zones for maritime services and marine equipment suppliers. It also hosts educational and training institutions focused on the maritime field, creating a well-rounded ecosystem for industry growth and innovation.

Strategically located near Dubai’s key ports and transport networks, Dubai Maritime City provides excellent connectivity to international trade routes. This advantageous positioning ensures efficient logistics, easy access for businesses and residents, and strengthens its role as a vital link in the global maritime chain.
